finding.claim: unifiedDiff does not handle append-only changes: when before is a prefix of after, start is -1 with different lengths so it does not return early and then indexes beforeLines[-1]/afterLines[-1] producing undefined diff lines.
finding.title: unifiedDiff emits undefined lines for prefix append

verifier.reason: Confirmed at patch/index.mjs:152-159: when beforeLines is a line-prefix of afterLines findIndex returns -1, the equality guard at patch/index.mjs:153 does not return because lengths differ, the suffix loop cannot remove the -1 start, and both output loops begin at index -1, pushing '-'+beforeLines[-1] and '+'+afterLines[-1] i.e. '-undefined'/'+undefined'.

patch.searchBlock:
const start = beforeLines.findIndex(function (line, index) { return line !== afterLines[index]; });
  if (start === -1 && beforeLines.length === afterLines.length) return "";
patch.rationale: When before is a prefix of after, findIndex returns -1 but lengths differ so the early return is skipped, causing indexing at -1. Normalizing -1 to the common prefix length makes the diff emit only the appended lines.
patch.reason: control passed 3/3 and the trigger passed 3/3 after the patch (differential proof)

finding.claim: Usage aggregation buckets every non-scanner/non-repro role into verifier, so scanner-secondary, verifier-secondary and patcher calls are misreported as verifier calls with the wrong model bucket.

evidence.snippet:
for (const call of agents.callLog) {
    const role = call.role === "scanner" ? "scanner-correctness" : call.role === "repro" ? "repro" : "verifier";

finding.title: secondary and patcher calls aggregated as verifier

verifier.reason: The ternary at cli.mjs:566 maps only scanner and repro explicitly and defaults every other role to verifier, while agents/index.mjs:110-133 defines distinct patcher, scanner-secondary, and verifier-secondary agents with different model fallbacks, and cli.mjs:568 fixes the bucket model from the first aggregated call, so those calls are misreported as verifier usage.

repro.expectedBehavior: Usage aggregation should preserve distinct roles such as scanner-secondary, verifier-secondary, and patcher instead of bucketing them as verifier.
repro.rationale: The defective aggregation at cli.mjs:565-576 is inline inside the non-exported main() function. cli.mjs exports only buildRunBanner, which does not accept a call log or perform usage aggregation, and no other listed module exports a callLog-to-byRole aggregation API. Exercising the defect would require running the complete analyze CLI pipeline, including repository ingestion, mock or model agents, scan/verify phases, and reading the generated run.json from the filesystem, rather than calling an imported repository symbol with different inputs.
repro.reason: No exported API exposes the usage-aggregation logic; it is embedded in cli.mjs main() and only reachable through a full CLI run.
